question: How do the senses follow the mind in yogic transfer?
premises: Bees follow their king when he rises and settles.
The mind functions as the leader of the senses.
Sense activities depend on the mind's movement.
inference: Therefore all sense activities follow the mind just as bees follow their king.
plain_english: Just as bees rise when the bee-king rises and settle when he settles, so all the activities of the senses follow the mind.
